title: Test CSS override placement
scenario: An application developer wants to recolor the whole page or one section without losing Rivinia's defaults. This frame compares the real theme layer, an unlayered root override, a scoped section, and a component-token precedence trap.
tryIt: Select the layered override and compare it with the unlayered default.
Choose the section override to keep the page surface light and the section dark.
Choose the component-token case to see its surface stay light inside the dark section.
